constructions.title: What the unmentioned map values are made of

klima_id_without_documentation.n_composi.is: Values in `klima_id_without_documentation` that join several ids in one value: split at a semicolon, an ampersand or a comma, more than one part remains.

Of those joined values, the ones with at least one part that some plan project page cites (`projects.*.klima_ids`) or some other plan page mentions (`klima_id_only_mentioned_outside_the_project_register`). A part written without a letter prefix takes the first part's prefix.

klima_id_without_documentation.n_no_digi.is: Values in `klima_id_without_documentation` with no digit in them, so no structure number: a place name or a placeholder for an unstated id.

constructions.what: Counts, over the list of mapped `klima_id` values that no plan page mentions, the values that join several ids, the joined values of which some part is cited after all, and the values that carry no number.
constructions.model: `id_parts()` in `scripts/report.py` splits a value at `;`, `&` or `,`, strips each part and gives a part that starts with no letter the first part's letter prefix. A value is joined if it has more than one part; its part is cited if it is in the union of the ids `build_registry.py` found on project pages and the ids it found only on other plan pages. A value with no digit matches no `\d`.
assumptions: A part of a joined value names the same structure as the single id with that text, so a joined value whose part is cited is not wholly unmentioned.
A value without a digit is not a structure number.

justified.text: The parts and the cited set are read from the same register the unmentioned list comes from, so the counts are subsets of that list counted by one rule.
The list of unmentioned values holds the values as the map layers carry them, joined values included, after `norm_id` has removed spaces and upper-cased them.

gaps: A joined value whose parts are all uncited is still counted as unmentioned, and whether its parts are separate structures is not checked.
The split does not handle ranges or other separators the layers might use.
void_if: the map layers change how they join several ids in one value
build_registry.py starts splitting joined values itself
constructions.licenses: How many of the unmentioned map values are joined values, joined values with a cited part, or values without a number.
constructions.not_licensed: How many distinct structures the plan leaves undescribed.

confirmed.by: agent w3-fr (written against id_parts() and the counting lines in scripts/report.py main(), and build_registry.py norm_id and the orphan list; counts checked by hand against registry.json; 2026-09-11; not yet read by the project owner)

constructions.title: Municipalities in the fetched discharge-point layer

municipalities.count.is: Distinct `komm_navn` values over the features of the layer as fetched.

constructions.what: How many municipalities the fetched layer of rain-dependent discharge points covers.
constructions.model: The set of `komm_navn` values over every feature, counted in `scripts/report.py`.
assumptions: Every feature carries the municipality it lies in.

justified.text: The national layer was clipped by `komm_navn` on fetch, so the municipalities present are the ones the fetch kept.

gaps: Which municipalities the fetch was asked for is recorded in the fetch script, not in the layer; a municipality with no discharge point would not appear.
void_if: the layer is refetched for other municipalities and the page is not rebuilt
constructions.licenses: The municipalities the page's counts of discharge points cover.
constructions.not_licensed: Anything about municipalities outside the fetch.

confirmed.by: agent w3-fr (written against the municipality set in scripts/report.py and the fetched layer, nine komm_navn values counted by hand; 2026-09-11; not yet read by the project owner)

constructions.title: Where the fetch table stops

cap.n_directions.is: Directions in the fetch table, one entry per five degrees.

cap.n_at_max.is: Directions whose fetch equals the table's largest value exactly.

cap.first_deg_at_max.is: The smallest direction key, in degrees, among the entries equal to the largest value.

cap.last_deg_at_max.is: The largest direction key, in degrees, among the entries equal to the largest value.

constructions.what: Whether the fetch table's largest value is a distance or a ceiling: how many directions hold it exactly, and between which directions they lie.
constructions.model: In `scripts/seabed.py`, the largest value of the table is found and the keys whose value equals it exactly are collected and counted; the first and last of them, sorted as integers, are stored as paths of the file.
assumptions: A round value repeated exactly over several directions is a limit on the ray, not a coincidence of coastlines.

justified.text: The count and the directions are read from the same table the wave model reads, with exact equality, so nothing is estimated.

gaps: No script in the repository writes the table, so the ceiling cannot be confirmed from code: that it is one is argued from the repeated exact value.
void_if: the table is recomputed with a different ray length or from another point
constructions.licenses: That the table's largest fetch is where it stops, and in which directions.
constructions.not_licensed: The true distance to the coast in those directions.

confirmed.by: agent w3-fr (written against the cap lines in scripts/seabed.py main() and data/raw/weather/fetch.json, whose seven exact maxima were listed by hand; 2026-09-11; not yet read by the project owner)

constructions.title: Secchi readings at the bed, over every paired reading

secchi.at_bed_pct.is: Of the readings in `maaledybde.csv.gz` with a positive `SigtDybde_m`, a positive `BundDybde_m` and a dated `StartDato` (the count `secchi.n_paired`), the percentage whose Secchi depth reaches the recorded bottom depth less a centimetre. Not the supplier's `SigtTilBund` flag, which is tallied over every reading with a Secchi depth.

constructions.what: The share of all paired Secchi readings in which the disc reached the recorded bed, over every bottom depth together.
constructions.model: `read_secchi()` pairs each Secchi reading $s$ with the bottom depth $b$ on the same record and applies `at_bed`, $100 \cdot \#\{s \ge b - 0.01\} / n$, to all the pairs at once; the per-band shares apply the same rule within each band.
assumptions: A Secchi depth equal to the recorded bottom depth means the disc was on the bed, not that the water happened to be exactly that clear.

justified.text: The rule is the one the per-band shares use, applied to the whole paired set, so the overall share and the band shares are counted alike.
The share is stored over the paired rows, the same rows `n_paired` counts.

gaps: The share is not checked record by record against the supplier's `SigtTilBund` flag; the flag is set on more readings, counted over a larger set, and how far the two agree is not computed.
void_if: the depth register is refetched and light.py is not rerun
constructions.licenses: How often, over the paired record, the recorded Secchi depth reaches the recorded bed.
constructions.not_licensed: The true clarity of the water where the disc reached the bed, or agreement with the supplier's flag.
